title: fix(ui): grouped grid and used-currency read treat a cut grouped answer as partial
body:
Fixes #37278

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在设了默认分页大小的部署上,按服务器分组的表格在分组数超过一页时,顶部多一行提示「更多分组未加载」,且不再报出偏少的记录总数;表单里币种字段的「可用」组在币种读取被截断时不再只列出部分已用币种,改为不列已用币种(所有币种仍在「全部」组里可选)。
- 为什么做:分组表头查询在被服务器截断时,上一张卡已把「截断」信号传给前端,但只有看板读了它;这次补上分组表格和币种读取两处,把同一族问题收口。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是分组表格多一行提示、批量栏不显示「全选 N 条」,或币种「可用」组少列已用币种;不会显示错误数字,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

Both readers of `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders` that `#36870` left reading a cut answer as whole now read `hasMore`:

- **Server-grouped grid** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`): `useServerGroupHeaders` reports `partial` when any depth's answer says `hasMore`. The grid then draws one status line above the rows (`grid.grouping.moreGroupsNotLoaded`, "More groups were not loaded: this view has more groups than the server returns in one read, so only some are listed.", translated in all eleven locale packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`) and in the grid's English fallback map), and `serverGroupTotalOf` tells no record total instead of summing the listed groups' counts. Listed groups keep their exact counts. A whole answer draws exactly as before.
- **Used-currency read** (`@object-ui/components`): `readUsedCurrencyCodes` reads a partial answer as no codes, so the code field gets what a failed read gives it (home + rated + the record's own code under "available"; every code stays under "all"). This is the kanban lane statistic's shape (a cut answer is read as no answer), not a second marker.
- **Nit N2** (`@object-ui/types`): `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer`'s jsdoc warns that `hasMore` lives on the array and a copy drops it. The type is declared in `ui/packages/types/src/data.ts` (the claim named the import site in `data-objectstack`).
- **Nit N1**: `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx` says the answer can be partial and how to read the flag.

Relation to `objectui#10881` ruling F: that ruling retired the `grid.grouping.partial*` keys, the marker over a grid that grouped one fetched page, whose every count was a page slice; this note is a separate key outside that namespace, because here every listed group's count is the server's exact count and only the group list is cut, so it says more groups were not loaded rather than marking the counts partial.

Why a marker / no-answer and not a re-read, for both readers: measured at the public door, a grouped read cannot be completed by the caller. `EngineAggregateOptions` (the header query's contract) carries no `limit`, the grouped branch of `POST /data/:object/query` slices in memory and reads no `offset`, and an explicit `limit` over the maximum page size is refused with `400 MAX_RECORDS_EXCEEDED`. Completing the currency read would need a contract change to the header query; it is not cheap, so it is not done here.

## Tests

<details><summary>Reach: both readers' query is cut at the public door (temporary probe, not committed)</summary>

A throwaway test beside `packages/rest/src/data-query-read-limits.test.ts` (same harness: real `SqlDriver` on SQLite, the real `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` route, five rows, five distinct `label` values) sent the header query exactly as `compileListViewGroupQuery` compiles it for both readers, with no `limit`. Tree: objectstack, base 08bf7d2a.

```
PROBE query {"groupBy":["label"],"aggregations":[{"function":"count","alias":"count"}]}
PROBE cut 200 {"n":2,"hasMore":true,"total":5}                 OS_DATA_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE=2
PROBE maxOnly 200 {"n":3,"hasMore":true}                       OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE=3 alone
PROBE whole 200 {"n":5,"hasMore":false}                        no limits
PROBE explicit-limit-3 200 {"n":3,"hasMore":true}              default 2, max 3, limit 3
PROBE explicit-limit-4-over-max 400 "MAX_RECORDS_EXCEEDED"     default 2, max 3, limit 4
```

Both readers send that query with no `limit` (`useServerGrouping.ts`, `usedCurrencyCodes.ts`), so both reach users on any deployment whose default page size is below the group count. The grid reaches users on the hosted plane's figure (maximum page size 5,000) for a grouping with more than 5,000 distinct values. The used-currency read groups an ISO 4217 code field (domain-checked on write, so at most one group per code plus the empty group, under 200): it reaches users only where a deployment sets a default page size below the number of codes in use. Both are fixed.
</details>

<details><summary>Pins, and the ablation that turns each red</summary>

New pins, each driven by a double that answers the compiled header query the way the door does under a default page size (every group, sliced to the page, `hasMore` on the answer when the slice dropped one), each beside a control with a whole answer:

- `serverGrouping-7189.test.tsx`, new top-level describe: a cut answer (page 3 of 5 groups) draws the partial note and the listed groups' exact counts; the control (page 100) draws five groups and no note; `useServerGroupHeaders` reports `partial` and `serverGroupTotalOf` tells no total over the cut answer, 186 over the whole one.
- `form-used-currency-codes-27188.test.tsx`, new top-level describe: a cut answer (page 2 of 4 groups) hands down no used codes; the control (page 10) hands down `EUR, GBP, USD`; `readUsedCurrencyCodes` on a flagged and an unflagged answer.

Run, at head `f652fe491`:

```
pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/ THE_TWO_PIN_FILES
 Test Files  113 passed (113)
      Tests  2052 passed | 13 skipped (2065)
```

That run holds the whole i18n package, including `groupingPartialRetired-10881.test.ts`, `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` and the key-parity tests. The ablation below was measured at `cf697b4f9`; the rename at `f652fe491` changes only the key and test-id names it reads.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 -> 0 on disk, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; the tests import the sources directly, no `dist/` in the path):

```
useServerGrouping.ts  partial = headers.some(... hasMore === true)  ->  partial = false
  x says more groups were not loaded, over the groups it did get
  x folds no record total over a cut answer — and the whole total over a whole one
  Tests  2 failed | 12 passed (14)        (both controls stay green)
usedCurrencyCodes.ts  the hasMore early return deleted
  x a cut answer hands down no used codes — never the groups it happened to list   (expected [ 'EUR', 'USD' ] to be undefined)
  x readUsedCurrencyCodes reads a partial answer as no codes, a whole one as its codes
  Tests  2 failed                          (control stays green)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The retired `grid.grouping.partial*` namespace stays empty: `groupingPartialRetired-10881.test.ts` is untouched and green.
- A partial grid tells the bulk bar no total, so "Select all N" is not offered with a wrong N there; the listed groups and their rows work as before.
- Completing either read would need the header query to carry a `limit` (a change to `EngineAggregateOptions`) and the grouped read to page; this PR does not go there.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useServerGrouping.ts` (the one `hasMore` read for the grid), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGrouping.ts` (`serverGroupTotalOf`), `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/usedCurrencyCodes.ts` (`readUsedCurrencyCodes`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/serverGrouping-7189.test.tsx` — expect the three `objectstack#37278` cases green beside the existing ones.

Readings at head `f652fe491`: type-check of `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/i18n` all `Done` (`@object-ui/types` at `cf697b4f9`, unchanged since) (lock VERDICT command-exit 0); the run above 2052 passed.
